title: hooks/test_install_src.sh ran past 10 minutes locally: measure whether it is slow or hung
why: Builder 2 (sonnet) of the standing-merge-role hook lane, 19:52 CST Nov 17: it started the full hooks/test_install_src.sh, it ran past 10 minutes, and it stopped it. Owner, 19:57 CST Nov 17: 'prob some kinda bug'.
source: builder report 19:52 CST Nov 17; owner message 19:57 CST Nov 17; CI times read from REST by triage (below)
note: Measured (REST, workflow checks on main, 25 completed runs, created to updated, includes queue and one retry): about 20 to 100 minutes per run, newest run 100 minutes and red. No per-job or per-step time was read, so whether the install suite alone is slow, hung or just large is unmeasured. First act (read only): per-case timing of the install suite in one CI log, and a local run with timing on one case at a time. Then decide: a hung case is a bug (fix lane, test-author first); a slow suite goes to step ci-skip-untouched-steps. Proof: per-case seconds with n.
